title: What "Works" Means Here
description: Define success for a non-deterministic, multi-step system in checkable terms — before you run it, not after you like the output.

title: Building an Eval Set
description: Assemble cases that expose real weaknesses rather than confirming success — sourced from real failures, covering the boring, the hard, and the adversarial.

title: Grading Output
description: Score agent output automatically in a way that agrees with human judgement — rubrics, model-as-judge, and checking a grader against real humans.

title: Catching Regressions
description: Notice when a change made things worse, including a change you didn't make — running evals as a habit, comparing runs meaningfully despite variance, and a dashboard worth actually looking at.
